command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04','CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){ foreach(`$n in @('AGG_SW_01','Core_SW_01')){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; if(`$o -notlike 'Error:*'){ '### '+`$p+' '+`$n; `$o -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match 'bpdu-filter|ospf cost|stp instance.*cost|traffic-policy|qos |mtu |bandwidth'} } } }"
